name: Veil-ian #06
description: A veiled figure for Veil: a crowned mask over layered, patterned cloth falling to an uneven hem. Crown: Fan. Aperture: Woven band. Ornament: Basketweave. Palette: Gold. Hem: Long fringe. Its hem is shared with one other in the set of 20. No face — where the cloth is open, it is cloth removed rather than features drawn on.
